listing.name: Snowboard Kids (SnowboardKids-Recomp)
listing.summary: Explore Snowboard Kids (SnowboardKids-Recomp) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep the complete package for your system
steps.instruction: Keep the Snowboard Kids (HikariLucy) package files together. On Windows, that is SnowboardKidsEngine.exe, the matching modules/snowboardkids-us/SnowboardKidsGame.dll, assets and runtime DLLs together. The published beta has a precompiled module; normal players do not compile anything. If your copy instead requires module generation or repair, finish that supported preparation upstream before attachment.

steps.title: Select your own supported original on Play
steps.instruction: Choose your own supported Snowboard Kids (USA), game code NSKE, through the upstream ROM chooser. Upstream ROM-IDENTITY.md specifies its normalized identity and supported N64 byte orders. Preserve that original separately. Portcove does not acquire, upload, copy, patch or authenticate the ROM through this attachment route.

steps.title: Review the game, working folder and launch details
steps.instruction: Select the completed native SnowboardKidsEngine.exe with the established package root as working directory and only its supported literal arguments. Review the launch details, add the game, then choose Play. Keep one upstream/player owner for preparation and runtime replacement. Removing the registration preserves every external file; Core supplies no external update, backup, rollback, conversion, migration or deletion.

warnings: The package includes a modified RecompFrontend fork by cdlewis that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files. Source and first-party checks do not confirm gameplay, real saves or installed behavior.

Loading a savestate does not rewind Controller Pak storage. An explicit --module or SBK_GAME_MODULE and modules in the user-data directory take priority over the bundled module: review and preserve the actual selected module and compatible creating engine together. Package integrity does not certify an external override. Stop actual players before deliberate upstream replacement and review/relink a changed executable.

references.title: Preserve the actual profile and active module
references.instruction: Keep the complete creating package, original and effective profile before maintenance. The normal Windows profile is %APPDATA%/SnowboardKids; SBK_USER_DATA_DIR can select another root, and resolver fallbacks must be preserved in their actual locations.
